title: Automation outside AWS integrated services - AWS Certificate Manager
note: Q1 question rewrite (SAA task 1.3): ACM's ACME protocol support lets a standard ACME client automate issuance and renewal of a certificate directly on infrastructure outside ACM's integrated services, such as a self-managed EC2 web server; ACME-issued certificates cannot be attached to Elastic Load Balancing, CloudFront, or API Gateway.
